title: Back at Hack the North, This Time as a Volunteer
subtitle: Hack the North 2026
paragraphs: A year after attending Hack the North, I returned to the University of Waterloo, this time as a volunteer.

Having experienced the event as a participant, I was interested in seeing things from the other side. Volunteering gave me a better appreciation for the coordination behind an event involving so many students.
It was nice to contribute to the local tech community in a different way. After attending hackathons and competitions throughout first year, helping out felt like a natural next step.
I still enjoy the technical side of hackathons, but I’ve also started to appreciate the communities behind them: the people who make it possible to meet, learn, and work on something new.
